decisions.reason: A low-pile decorative carpet close to the existing range needs little investment and has no strong public commitment, but it launched only in 2023 and still has its own page, so there is not yet evidence of lasting failure.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the craftsmanship and fine materials the firm publicly emphasizes, so dropping it would contradict the stated direction and write off sourcing effort.
This decorative carpet is a low-investment collection item, but one year is too early to attribute any weak results to anything other than temporary market conditions.
The corner bench builds on the core furniture offer and likely involved design collaboration and tooling, so the sunk investment and designer commitment favor keeping it.
A low-pile carpet with little invested and no visible commitment could be pruned easily, but it is too new for its results to rule out temporary causes.
The swivel shell chair is a designer seating piece central to the residential and workplace offer, with substantial development investment that management would want to justify by persisting.
